records.title: Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference: Theory and Practice
records.reason: RAD and SLAI route and schedule prefill/decode requests against throughput and time-to-token objectives; the abstract reports serving capacity and TTFT improvements.

records.title: IterQuant: Iterative Quantization Framework for Mixed-Precision LLM Compression
records.reason: The DATE 2026 proceedings abstract describes iterative mixed-precision quantization of LLMs, directly reducing model footprint while preserving output quality.

records.title: SinkRouter: Sink-Aware Routing for Efficient Long-Context Decoding in Large Language and Multimodal Models
records.reason: SinkRouter selects attention computation from KV-cache sink signals and reports decoding speedup at long contexts; this is direct LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: MARS: Enabling Autoregressive Models Multi-Token Generation
records.reason: MARS targets multi-token autoregressive generation per forward pass, a direct mechanism for reducing sequential decoding work.

records.title: TIDE: Token-Informed Depth Execution for Per-Token Early Exit in LLM Inference
records.reason: TIDE performs token-wise early exit during LLM inference; the abstract reports lower prefill latency and higher throughput.

records.title: Mitigating the impact of activation smoothing on weights: A channel permutation and smoothing-based LLMs quantization method
records.reason: The Springer abstract reports W4A8 LLM quantization, 1.74x memory savings, and 1.45x inference speedup; this is directly about deployment efficiency.

records.title: CLAA: Cross-Layer Attention Aggregation for Accelerating LLM Prefill
records.reason: CLAA aggregates token-importance scores across layers for LLM prefill and reports up to 39% lower TTFT.

records.title: WiSparse: Boosting LLM Inference Efficiency with Weight-Aware Mixed Activation Sparsity
records.reason: WiSparse uses weight-aware, mixed-granularity activation sparsity and improved sparse kernels to lower LLM inference computation.

records.title: FastUSP: A Multi-Level Collaborative Acceleration Framework for Distributed Diffusion Model Inference
records.reason: The primary abstract targets FLUX/Stable Diffusion and Qwen-Image distributed inference; it does not establish an LLM-serving or LLM-inference contribution.

records.title: Structured Pruning of LLMs for Resource-Constrained Devices: A Survey
records.reason: The IEEE abstract surveys structured LLM pruning methods for resource-constrained deployment, a concrete model-size and inference-resource efficiency path.

records.title: LLM-CoOpt: A Co-Design and Optimization Framework for Efficient LLM Inference on Heterogeneous Platforms
records.reason: Opt-KV, Opt-GQA, and paged long-sequence processing target KV access, attention work, and memory pressure; the abstract reports throughput and latency gains.

records.title: FlattenGPT: Depth Compression for Transformer with Layer Flattening
records.reason: FlattenGPT reduces transformer depth by merging adjacent blocks and targets model compression and acceleration; this is an inference-model efficiency technique.

records.title: LittleBit-2: Maximizing the Spectral Energy Gain in Sub-1-Bit LLMs via Latent Geometry Alignment
records.reason: LittleBit-2 is a sub-1-bit LLM quantization method; the abstract explicitly reports no inference overhead while targeting extreme model compression.

records.title: RaBiT: Residual-Aware Binarization Training for Accurate and Efficient LLMs
records.reason: RaBiT addresses residual co-adaptation in binary LLM inference and develops a hardware-friendly low-bit model representation.

records.title: SDFP: Speculative Decoding with FIT-Pruned Models for Training-Free and Plug-and-Play LLM Acceleration
records.reason: SDFP constructs speculative-decoding draft models by pruning layers, directly reducing draft inference latency and deployment overhead.

records.title: DynSplit-KV: Dynamic Semantic Splitting for KVCache Compression in Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
records.reason: DynSplit-KV targets long-context KV-cache memory and retrieval overhead with semantic splitting and fixed-length mapping.

records.title: PRISM: Parametrically Refactoring Inference for Speculative Sampling Draft Models
records.reason: PRISM refactors speculative draft-model computation to decouple model capacity from inference cost and reports lower draft latency and end-to-end speedup.

records.title: HyperOffload: Graph-Driven Hierarchical Memory Management for Large Language Models on SuperNode Architectures
records.reason: HyperOffload is a compiler/runtime memory-management framework for LLM SuperNode systems that schedules transfers to hide communication stalls.

records.title: HyLRA: Hybrid Layer Reuse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
records.reason: HyLRA reuses attention indices across tolerant layers while preserving full attention at sensitive layers to reduce long-context inference work.

records.title: LINA: Linear Autoregressive Image Generative Models with Continuous Tokens
records.reason: LINA studies compute-efficient linear attention for text-to-image autoregressive generation; the primary abstract describes an image-generation application, not LLM systems.
